researcher.body: For an airline booking, the free checked-bag allowance does not specify how many bags the customer needs. Do not infer the requested quantity from that allowance. If the actual quantity is unclear, ask for it and include the quantity in the confirmation before booking. Apply the current policy's limit of one certificate per reservation when assembling payment methods. Recheck all other booking details against the current conversation.
